module_summary: Dual-issue RISC-V register file: 31 flop registers with two prioritized write ports (rd0 over rd1) and four asynchronous case-mux read ports.

anchors.name: REGFILE.reg_r1_q
anchors.why: Representative of the 31 flop registers x1..x31 holding architectural register values.

anchors.name: rd0_i
anchors.why: Write port 0 destination register index; has priority when writing each register.

anchors.name: rd0_value_i
anchors.why: Write port 0 data written into selected register.

anchors.name: rd1_i
anchors.why: Write port 1 destination index, lower priority than rd0.

anchors.name: rd1_value_i
anchors.why: Write port 1 data written when rd1_i selects register.

anchors.name: ra0_i
anchors.why: Read port index selecting register in the read case mux; representative of four read addresses.

anchors.name: ra0_value_o
anchors.why: Read port data output; representative of the four read value outputs.

anchors.name: REGFILE.ra0_value_r
anchors.why: Asynchronous read mux result selecting register by ra0_i.

groups.name: register_array
groups.description: 31 flop registers x1..x31, x0 hardwired zero, with debug alias wires.

groups.name: write_ports
groups.description: Two write ports; rd0 has priority over rd1 per register.

groups.name: read_muxes
groups.description: Four asynchronous case-mux read ports returning zero for x0.
